club policy.pdf: Club Policy Handbook  Preface The Vihang Club Policy Book serves as the foundational framework for maintaining consistency, transparency, and professionalism in all operations of the Vihang Club. It outlines the standards and procedures that guide the recruitment of new members, governance of ongoing activities, and responsible management of club resources. These policies are designed not merely as rules, but as guiding principles that ensure Vihang continues to uphold its core vision — to cultivate innovation, discipline, and teamwork among its members while promoting hands-on learning and technological excellence. Every student, member, and team lead is expected to understand and comply with these policies to ensure smooth functioning and to maintain the integrity of the club. This document is reviewed periodically by the Core Team and the Faculty Advisor to ensure that all policies remain relevant and aligned with the club’s objectives and institutional standards. Approved by: Prof. S. B. Project Brief Report.pdf: HANDSHAKE PROJECT NAME: Receiver and Transmitter using NRF24L Module and STM Microcontroller PROJECT GROUP: Sahil Khandare & Pratik Khadse WHY THIS PROJECT ? This project was undertaken to create an alternative to the existing Flysky transmitter– receiver system. Our goal is to design and develop a custom transmitter and receiver tailored specifically to our requirements. These requirements will evolve based on the future competitions the club participates in. Our mission is to develop and build all electronic components in-house, ensuring full control over performance, customization and innovation. INTRODUCTION This project is developed using an STM microcontroller paired with the NRF24L01 wireless module. Both the PCB and the firmware were designed and built entirely in-house. The NRF24L01 was selected primarily for its high data rate, which supports fast and efficient communication between the transmitter and receiver. However, during development, we realized that this choice came with a trade-off—our focus on speed led us to overlook the module’s limited operational range. KEY FEATURES ARCHITECTURE 1. Custom Firmware Development: Entire firmware written in-house, allowing complete control over optimization. 2. In-House PCB Development: Custom-designed PCB tailored specifically for the transmitter–receiver architecture. 3.
